manifest.keeps: Every setting, every service's own configuration, and your whole library.

outside.by_hand: Quit Docker Desktop, then drag Docker from Applications to the Bin — or brew uninstall --cask docker if you installed it that way
outside.why: lemonfiber runs on the container engine and did not install it. Removing it would take every other project's containers with it.

outside.by_hand: Quit Jellyfin, drag it from Applications to the Bin, and remove ~/.local/share/jellyfin — which holds its own library database
outside.what: a media server you installed natively
outside.why: Running the media server outside a container is something you chose and set up yourself, so nothing here knows what it was told or what it wrote.

outside.by_hand: Quit Tailscale and drag it from Applications to the Bin
outside.what: a tunnel client such as Tailscale
outside.why: Reaching this machine from outside the house is arranged with software you installed, and other things on this machine may be reached through it.

outside.by_hand: brew uninstall lemonfiber if you installed it that way, or delete the binary — rm $(command -v lemonfiber)
outside.why: This program is running, and a program does not remove itself out from under the command you are reading this in.

manifest.removes: The containers, the networks they were on, and the images that were pulled for them.
